statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail eases from 16 to 13 because the cross-asset amplifiers have stepped back from their session extremes while NQ has held its low. NQ trades 29,407.75 against a 29,538.75 settle, 74 points above the 29,333.25 low, with the 29,633.75 high also intact, so neither extreme has been extended this hour. VIX is 16.54 against a 16.68 session high, the 10-year is 4.845% against a 4.857% high, and Brent at $101.08 and WTI at $96.09 have both come off their peaks. Stress stays extreme at 82 because $100 crude and a near-multi-year-high 10-year remain a demanding backdrop, not because mean reversion has failed.
recommendation: Tail at 13 maps to EA_ON for both NQ futures and the NAS100 CFD and sits well below the block threshold. The danger window is unchanged at 17:00-18:00 UTC, where the US 10-year note auction and the Apple keynote coincide within the next hour; conditional tail is 18 in that slot and 16 in the digestion hour after it. The joint highest conditional reading in the window is 18 at 12:00 and 13:00 UTC on 10 September, covering August PPI, core PPI, initial jobless claims and the following cash open. No forecast hour reaches the watch band. Existing-position management and emergency protection are unaffected by the mapped state.
headline: NQ holds 29,407.75 with both session extremes intact as VIX 16.54, the 10-year 4.845% and Brent $101.08 all step back from their highs; tail eases to 13 into the 17:00 UTC auction and Apple keynote
body:
The defining feature of this hour is what did not happen. NQ has neither taken out the 29,333.25 session low nor revisited the 29,633.75 high, trading 29,407.75, down 0.44% on a 29,538.75 settle. Investing.com shows the same structure at 29,431.75 on an identical 29,333.00 low and 29,633.75 high. The NASDAQ-100 cash index sits at 29,369.43, down 0.47% from a 29,507.70 close, inside a 29,334.40 to 29,563.60 range. Earlier in the session the index completed a full round trip, selling to the low around the 13:30 UTC cash open and recovering the entire 281-point distance before giving it back. A path that retraces its own moves in both directions is the opposite of the structure that overwhelms a mean-reversion approach.

The cross-asset picture, which hardened through the previous hour, has now softened at the margin. VIX is 16.54, up 5.22% on a 15.72 close but below the 16.68 session high it set earlier. The 10-year is 4.845%, up 3.9 basis points from 4.806%, having peaked at 4.857%; the 5-year at 4.614% is likewise off a 4.620% high, and the 13-week bill at 3.810% is up 3.5 basis points. Brent trades $101.08 and WTI $96.09, each up roughly 3.2% but below the $101.39 and $96.55 seen an hour ago. Three amplifiers that were simultaneously printing session highs are now simultaneously off them, which is the difference between a building alignment and one that is decaying.

Index internals also conflict rather than align. The PHLX Semiconductor Index is 11,890.97, up 0.03% on the day, while the NASDAQ-100 is down 0.47%; semiconductors holding flat against a falling index is a divergence, not confirmation. Apple at $313.54 and Nvidia at $223.85 are each down about 0.85%, in line with the index rather than leading it lower. Under the standing framework, conflicting internals raise uncertainty and stress; they do not mechanically raise the probability of a denied-retracement path.

Tail is therefore reduced to 13 from 16. Stress is held at 82, still in the extreme band, because the underlying environment has not improved: crude remains above $100 on active US-Iran hostilities around the Strait of Hormuz, where US forces struck five Iranian tankers and Iran responded against shipping and a base in Jordan, and the 10-year is near its highest level since November 2023. Confidence is 88, supported by current live quotes for NQ, the cash index, VIX, the 2-year through 30-year curve proxies, crude, semiconductors and megacaps, plus a verified seven-day calendar. The shared Finviz cross-asset context was read but is roughly four and a half hours old and therefore outside its freshness bound, so it was not used; the assessment rests entirely on independently fetched primary sources.

The narrow danger window remains 17:00 to 18:00 UTC. The US 10-year note auction and Apple's 'Surprise and Shine' keynote land at the same instant, with the 10-year already near a session high. A poorly received auction into a market this sensitive to the long end is the one credible mechanism for a delayed second leg that could deny retracement, which is why conditional tail lifts to 18 there and holds 16 through the digestion hour. That remains a scheduled checkpoint rather than observed structure.
lookbackSummary: Across the 24 clock-hours from 16:00 UTC on 8 September to 15:00 UTC on 9 September the mapped state was EA_ON in every published hour except 12:00 UTC on 9 September, which was WATCH. Tail ran between 5 and 20, sitting between 5 and 9 for eighteen of the twenty-three published hours before breaking higher through the European morning: 15 at 11:00 UTC, a peak of 20 at 12:00 UTC as the session low extended to 29,333.25, 17 at 13:00 UTC as the first retracement appeared, 10 at 14:00 UTC once the whole down leg had been recovered, and 16 at 15:00 UTC as the recovery was given back. One hour, 10:00 UTC on 9 September, has no published assessment and is marked unavailable. Stress is the clearest trend in the window, climbing from 68 at 17:00 UTC on 8 September to 83 by 12:00 UTC on 9 September as crude advanced above $100 and the 10-year reached its highest level in nearly three years, easing only briefly to 80 before finishing the window at 83. Dominant mode was mixed in nineteen hours, normal in one, trend-down in two and event/whipsaw in one, the non-mixed directional readings clustering in the hours of the European break. Confidence held in a narrow 87 to 89 band throughout.
outlookSummary: The next 24 hours contain one high-impact US release cluster: August PPI, core PPI and initial jobless claims at 12:30 UTC on 10 September, which falls in the third-to-last forecast slot. August CPI on 11 September and the 16 September FOMC decision sit outside the window. Conditional tail runs in a 9 to 18 band and never reaches the watch band, so every one of the 24 slots maps to EA_ON. The path peaks at 18 twice: inside the published 17:00-18:00 UTC danger window, where the 10-year note auction and the Apple keynote coincide with the 10-year near a session high, and again across the 12:00 and 13:00 UTC hours on 10 September that carry the PPI and claims print and the cash open that follows it. The overnight stretch from 22:00 UTC to 05:00 UTC carries 9 with no scheduled US catalyst, where the residual risk is a Strait of Hormuz supply headline gapping a thin Globex book rather than a persistent trend. Conditional stress eases from 82 to about 75 overnight and rebuilds to 85 into the PPI release, on the assumption that the energy backdrop persists. Confidence decays from 88 to 72 across the window, which reflects the shrinking value of current price-path evidence rather than any expected deterioration in conditions.
